answer: The epoch needs a single honest test, and that test is Resin collector tincture vial warrant kept in the apothecary shop, proved by each tincture vial is a year of herb logs in the herb ledger, so a farm must collect. An honest agent risks 120 POA once. A farm risks 84480 POA every epoch, and the risk never shrinks. The garden is a paper, the vine is a coin, and the juniper is a fact — and the panel weighs facts, not paper. Honest work leaves a trail a stranger can follow; farm work leaves a trail a stranger can see through.
